gaps.sentence: We've decided to do ___ a holiday this year.
gaps.explanation: do without = manage without having something.

gaps.sentence: He puts his success down ___ hard work and a bit of luck.
gaps.explanation: put something down TO something = believe it has that cause.

gaps.sentence: The plane will drop ___ the parcels at the next farm.
gaps.explanation: drop off = deliver somebody/something; also become less (sales dropped off).

gaps.sentence: Their son grew ___ and moved abroad.
They want to try ___ the new software before buying.
gaps.explanation: try out = test something to see if it works.

gaps.sentence: We found ___ that the flight had been cancelled.
Who will take ___ from the current director?
gaps.explanation: take over = take control of a job/company.

gaps.sentence: During the tour she pointed ___ the oldest house in town.
gaps.explanation: point out = mention/draw attention to a fact.
